old: Triangles ACD and CBD are similar (each has a right angle, and ∠A = ∠BCD), so AD/CD = CD/DB, giving x(x + 5) = 36. Then x² + 5x − 36 = (x + 9)(x − 4) = 0, so x = 4 and AB = 4 + 9 = 13 cm. Area = ½ × 13 × 6 = 39 cm².
new: Triangles ACD and CBD are similar (each has a right angle, and ∠A = ∠BCD), so AD/CD = CD/DB, giving x(x + 5) = 36. Since 4 × 9 = 36, x = 4 and AB = 4 + 9 = 13 cm. Area = ½ × 13 × 6 = 39 cm².
why: Solving a quadratic by zero-product is Class 10; a product of two numbers 5 apart is within Class 8
